title: History Made at Lollapalooza
story:
On **July 31, 2022**, j-hope stepped onto the main stage of **Lollapalooza in Chicago** to make history. He became **the first South Korean artist to headline the main stage of a major U.S. music festival**.

This was no ordinary performance. Just two weeks earlier, he had released **Jack In The Box**, his first official solo album. Now, he was about to present this new chapter of his artistry to a huge festival audience - entirely on his own.

A HISTORIC SOLO PERFORMANCE

The show opened with **"MORE,"** immediately setting the tone for an intense, powerful performance. Over the next hour, j-hope performed **18 songs**, taking the audience on a journey through different stages of his musical career.

The set included tracks from Jack In The Box, such as **"Pandora's Box," "Arson," and "Future,"** as well as songs from his first mixtape, **Hope World**. He also brought his dance-focused solo track **"Trivia: Just Dance"** and BTS songs, including **"BTS Cypher Pt. 1"** and a tropical remix of **"Dynamite."**

One of the most unforgettable moments came during **"Chicken Noodle Soup."** Becky G, who collaborated with j-hope on the 2019 song, appeared on stage as a surprise guest. It was the first time the two artists performed the song together live, and their joyful reunion became one of the highlights of the night.

OVERCOMING HIS FEARS

But the performance was about much more than the setlist. For j-hope, stepping onto that stage meant facing his fears and proving to himself that he could do this. In his closing remarks, he admitted that the activities surrounding Jack In The Box had involved many moments of fear. He thanked the audience and said he wanted to tell himself how proud he was for overcoming those moments.

Jimin was also there, watching from the audience and cheering for his fellow BTS member. His presence was a touching reminder that even as j-hope stood on stage alone, he was not without the support of the people who had shared so much of his journey.

A NIGHT TO REMEMBER

He closed the historic night with **"Future,"** a fitting choice for an artist who was stepping into a new chapter of his career. As the final notes faded, he called out **"Chicago," "Lollapalooza," and "ARMY,"** celebrating the people who had made the moment so special.

Lollapalooza was more than a successful festival performance. It was a declaration that **j-hope could command a massive stage in his own right, as an artist with a distinct musical identity, a powerful performance style, and a story of his own to tell**.

That night, he didn't just make history. He showed the world what j-hope could do.
surpriseDescription: History was made when j-hope took the Lollapalooza stage as a headliner. Relive the energy, the music and the incredible performance that made this night unforgettable.

challenge.question: What made j-hope's Lollapalooza 2022 performance historic?
options: He became the first South Korean artist to headline the main stage of a major U.S. music festival.
He became the first BTS member to headline the main stage at Glastonbury Festival.
He became the first BTS member to headline the Super Bowl halftime show.
challenge.answer: He became the first South Korean artist to headline the main stage of a major U.S. music festival.
